entities.name: cafe-website

[__bicep.logGroup(parameters('workspaceId'), createArray(__bicep.logSignal('failed-menu-requests', 'Failed menu requests', 'AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5min)
| extend path = tostring(parse_url(Url).Path)

| summarize value = countif(Success == false)
', 'Count', variables('failureRules')), __bicep.logSignal('synthetic-browse-failures', 'Synthetic customer cannot open the menu', 'AppAvailabilityResults
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5min)

| summarize value = countif(Success == false)
', 'Count', variables('failureRules'))))]

', 'Count', variables('failureRules'))))]

', 'Count', variables('failureRules'))))]
